I have gathered enough information to provide a thorough answer.

Derived metadata is stored in `MemoPayload` under the `memo.payload` JSON column. It includes tags extracted from `#tag` syntax and properties such as `has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, and `title` (from the first H1 heading). The `snippet` preview is generated at read time via `GenerateSnippet` and is not persisted. `location` is set by the user and is not derived.

Mentions are extracted separately for notification purposes via `ExtractAll` in mention helpers, not stored as derived metadata.

Computation happens in three places. `internal/markdown/markdown.go` runs `ExtractAll` and `ExtractTatProperties` during a single markdown pass. `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` orchestrates `RebuildMemoPayload`. The snippet is generated at response time in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` via `getMemoContentSnippet`.

`CreateMemo` triggers recomputation by calling `RebuildMemoPayload` before persisting, including through `CreateMemoComment`.

`UpdateMemo` triggers recomputation only when the update mask targets the `content` field.

`memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` performs a batch rebuild of all memos. This is maintenance-only and is not wired to server startup.

The snippet is regenerated on every API response conversion, including `ListMemos` and `GetMemo`, through `convertMemoFromStore`.

Mentions are recomputed during create and update operations solely for notification dispatch; they are not stored in the payload.

The parser uses goldmark with GFM extensions. It includes custom extensions for `#tag` syntax and `@mention` syntax.
